A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same work, Contextual Causal Bayesian Optimisation, with complete main text and Appendices A–C. All 31 pages support comparison; extracted text and rendered page bodies match after excluding publication headers and version stamps.

before.justification: v3 reports original simulation experiments in Section 6 and Appendix A, including comparisons against CaBO and CoBO, noise sensitivity, and backend/context ablations.

after.justification: v4 retains these original simulation results in Section 6 and Appendix A, including the empirical plots in Figures 3 and 5–7.

M1.justification: The POMPS selection procedure, contextual GP optimisation, and updates in Algorithms 1 and 2 are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same PSA and synthetic SCM configurations, high-dimensional environment, noise conditions, and context-removal scenario in Section 6 and Appendix A.

E2.justification: Figure 3 retains the same CaBO and CoBO comparisons, Figure 6 retains CoBO, and Figure 7a retains the HEBO, BoTorch, and GPflow backend variants.

E3.justification: Both report 700 iterations/interventions, HEBO for the main comparisons, time-normalised cumulative regret, and cumulative scope-selection frequencies. The SCM settings in Appendix A are unchanged.

E4.justification: The noise-sensitivity study in Figure 5 and the backend and context ablations in Appendix A.5 and Figure 7 are identical.

E5.justification: Both versions specify 110 random seeds and report averages with error bars denoting 1.96 standard errors. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: The result curves and uncertainty bands in Figures 3 and 5–7 are visually identical, and their accompanying numerical statements, rankings, and qualitative findings are unchanged.

T1.justification: Definitions 1–3, Assumptions 1–2, Theorem 1, and the derivations and proofs in Appendices A–C are identical, including Table 3's information-gain bounds.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain identical claims about unifying contextual and causal BO, regret guarantees, convergence, and sample efficiency.

C2.justification: Explanations of baseline failure, scope-selection instability, and dimensionality benefits are unchanged. Both retain the known-graph restriction and the qualification about unclear convergence under extreme noise.

D1.justification: The HEBO/Pyro implementation descriptions, SCM specifications, and hardware information remain identical, including the 120-CPU system and single-core, 16 GB reproduction statement.

R1.justification: Section 5, the reference list, and the novelty and prior-work comparisons throughout the main text and appendices are unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 adds 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026' and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The body wording, section structure, and appendix organisation are identical.

P2.justification: v4 adds the publication header above the existing top rule on every page and changes the first-page marginal stamp. Figures 1–7, Tables 1–3, captions, and body layout remain identical.

improvement.justification: The publication header and version-stamp updates leave the scientific content, explanations, empirical evidence, and reproducibility information unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. They establish no meaningful net difference in paper quality.
